title: Rabbi David Tawil: Life Lessons From Pirke Abot- "Patience"

chapters.title: The trap of quick fixes
chapters.about: fad diets, get-rich-quick schemes, and societal impatience

chapters.title: Patience as a requirement for mastery
chapters.about: professional athletes, students, and career longevity

chapters.title: The myth of multitasking
chapters.about: lack of focus, productivity, and the long way being the short way

chapters.title: Patience, Emunah, and Bitachon
chapters.about: trusting Hashem during difficult times and avoiding compromise

summary: Rabbi Tawil discusses the importance of patience in personal growth, learning, and maintaining meaningful relationships. He explains how modern society's focus on quick fixes and multitasking often hinders true progress, and he connects the virtue of patience to Emunah, Bitachon, and the control of anger. The class concludes with practical applications for the upcoming High Holidays, emphasizing the value of patience in our interactions with others.
questions: Why does multitasking often make us less productive?
How does patience relate to our Emunah and Bitachon?
What does the Mishna in Pirkei Avot say about anger and forgiveness?
How can we apply the lesson of patience during the High Holidays?
